title: Order command
description: What the panel and the agent surface send to place an order (POST /api/v1/orders). Every number is a decimal string, never a JSON number. One variant per order type; a field of another type is refused. The runtime dedups on requestId and re-validates with its own tick, balances, position and leverage. Mirrors src/domain/orders/command.ts (OrderCommand). See decisions 0004 §1 and 0007 part 3 decision 4, and docs/reference/orders/validation.md.

millis.description: A duration in milliseconds, as a string.

timeInForce.description: Resting orders: cancel if still open this long after placement; above zero (zero is refused, HTTP 400). Absent with no cancelAt: one year (31536000000 ms), the API/MCP product default, independent of panel Settings (MH481).

instant.description: A moment, in milliseconds since the epoch (UTC), as a string.

cancelAt.description: Added in E16 (0011 d14): cancel the order if still open at this moment; not with timeInForce. The runtime journals it as the time in force from the order's send. Absent (and no timeInForce): one year for new API/MCP submissions, independent of panel Settings. Old journal rows retain no expiry.

exitTimeInForce.description: MH484: above zero and at most one year, 31536000000 milliseconds; over the limit is HTTP 400 with the house limit message, never silently cut.

oneTime.description: A moment or a duration, never both (0011 d14).

requestId.description: Caller-minted id (the panel uses a UUID); the runtime makes one order per id.

sourceId.description: The source the order is for: a venue account or a wallet, never the caller

instrumentId.description: The instrument id, e.g. BTC or xyz:SPCX.

type.description: The order type; each variant below fixes it and allows only that type's fields.

overrides.description: Keys of the warnings the user chose to send anyway. Only overridable warnings can be listed; errors cannot be overridden. A trading key's order is sent with its warnings whatever it lists here (RULINGS 75).

sizeUnit.description: base: the base asset; quote: the quote asset (on perps the notional, never the margin). A quote size is converted to base by the engine and floored to the size step; on spot a market buy's at the ask plus the 1 % entry cap, its limit at the exchange, so it never costs more than the amount.

reduceOnly.description: Only reduce the position. On a perpetual an order whose side and size close the position exactly, as gcx reads it when the order arrives, is sent reduce-only without it too, and gets no minimum-order-value warning (since 2026-10-05). On spot, which has no position, it is dropped and the order sent without it (since 2026-10-05; refused before).

delay.description: Timed placement: send after this long.

sendAt.description: Added in E16 (0011 d14): send at this moment; not with delay. The runtime journals it as the delay from its receipt; a moment not ahead of the runtime's clock is refused. Absent (and no delay): sent now.

expected.description: Deprecated (MH 2026-10-05): accepted and ignored. The order goes at the leverage and margin mode the exchange has when it is sent; set them with POST /api/v1/leverage. Until 2026-10-05 an order was refused when this differed from the exchange's.

gc-market.description: Market, cancelled if not filled within the venue's wait (legacy GC-Market). On an Ioc venue such as Hyperliquid it behaves as market.

triggerTimeout.description: After the first crossing, wait this long and fire only if the price is still across.

price.description: The limit price sent when the trigger fires.

postOnly.description: The limit sent at the trigger rests post-only (the DCA bot's averaging orders).

trailStart.description: Trailing starts when the price reaches this level; absent: from placement.

close.description: The exit order: market, reduce-only, sized by the runtime from the position. No side and no size.

bracket.description: Take-profit targets and one stop-loss attached to the order, placed on its fills. Every combination is valid here, including a limit take-profit with a stop-loss, by hand or from the DCA bot, on perps and on spot (ruling 381 b); on spot gcx's own stop-loss cancels the resting take-profit first and sells once the exchange confirmed the cancel (ruling 296 c).

reduceOnly.description: The take-profit and stop-loss only reduce the position (perpetuals). Default true: absent, the take-profit and stop-loss are reduce-only, whatever Settings › Trading says (MH 520); a received value is honoured. Spot has no reduce-only.

timeInForce.description: Added 2026-10-05 (MH, audit list 24): the take-profit and stop-loss's own time in force, one for both, counted from the order's full fill (on a position, from when they are set); at its end every one still open is cancelled, with one notice. Absent with no cancelAt: one year (31536000000 ms) for new API/MCP submissions, independent of panel Settings (MH481). Old journal rows retain no expiry. An older build ignores it.

cancelAt.description: C79 B2/B4: cancel both TP/SL legs at this UTC moment, not with timeInForce. MH480, MH484 (500 (1)): not before the entry's expiry and (a market or gc-market entry expires at its send; on a position or an order already filled, counted from acceptance): before the entry's expiry is HTTP 400, equality accepted; more than one year after it is the overridable warning trade.bracket.msgExpiryTooLong (HTTP 422 until named in overrides). A late full fill retains this end; the old journal failure path expires elapsed exits without placing. Older readers ignore this field and do not support absolute TP/SL expiry.

value.description: Percent, quote distance or price, per mode.

share.description: Percent of the parent's filled size this target closes.

minProfit.description: Percent; activation waits until this profit (improve-only).

mode.description: loss: value is the expected loss in quote.

follow.description: Follow TPs: move to break-even at the first target, or to the previous target at each. Off when absent.

levelMode.description: percent or quoted: a distance from the parent's price; price: an absolute level.
